body.text: To get a web design quote from Teknoppy, share a few details about your project, business type, the kind of website you need, your rough budget, and your timeline, and our team responds with a written estimate, not a generic price range. No pushy follow-up calls, no obligation to proceed.

sections.h2: How To Get Your Web Design Quote
sections.intro: Getting a web design quote from Teknoppy takes one short form, your name, business, the service you need, business website, WordPress, ecommerce, or web application, your rough budget range, and your timeline.

form.heading: Request Your Web Design Quote
form.successMessage: Thanks — your quote request is with us. Most quotes go out within one business day, usually sooner.
form.errorMessage: Something went wrong sending your request. Please call +91 6282249224 or email sales@teknoppy.com and we'll pick it up straight away.
form.note: That is it, no lengthy questionnaire before you even get a response. We do not ask for card details, and we do not require a call before you get a quote in writing.

aside.heading: Before You Request a Quote

items.text: A written quote with a specific price range tied to your actual project details, not a copy pasted range.
A response within one business day, usually sooner.
No obligation to proceed, you keep the quote and decide on your own timeline.
Getting a web design quote from Teknoppy does not commit you to anything.
Some businesses request quotes from three or four agencies before deciding; we would rather earn the work on the quote itself than pressure a decision.

sections.h2: Why Businesses Trust Teknoppy's Quote Process

items.html: Every web design quote is prepared by the same team that will actually design and develop your site, across our Website Design, WordPress, Ecommerce, and Web Application services, not a sales rep estimating blind.

items.text: The number in your quote is the number we will invoice, barring scope changes you approve along the way.
You get a written quote, not a verbal figure that shifts in the next conversation.

sections.h2: What A Real Quote Looks Like

paragraphs.text: A Kochi based retail business recently requested a web design quote for a six page site with WooCommerce integration and a bilingual layout.

The quote came back within a day, broken into base site cost, ecommerce setup, and bilingual content cost as separate line items, so the business could see exactly what each part cost before deciding what to keep and what to trim from the first draft of the scope.

items.label: Website Design and Development

items.label: Website Design Cost in Kerala
items.text: Our published pricing tiers, useful if you want a ballpark before submitting details.

items.label: Website Cost Calculator Kerala

items.q: How long does it take to get a web design quote from Teknoppy?
items.a: Most quotes go out within one business day of submitting the form, and more complex projects like custom web applications may take slightly longer to scope properly.

items.q: Is the quote free and non-binding?
items.a: Yes, there is no charge to request a quote and no obligation to proceed once you receive it.

items.q: How is this different from the Website Cost Calculator?
items.a: The calculator gives an instant, self-serve estimated range. Requesting a quote gets you a specific written number based on your actual project.

devNotes.notRendered: The doc's header block (word count, density, schema list) and its closing cannibalization check are build instructions, not page copy.
devNotes.h1Note: The doc's H1 reads 'Get a Web Design Quote - Teknoppy'. The brand suffix is kept in the meta title and dropped from the visible H1, which is how every other page on the site is set up.
devNotes.formNote: Budget and timeline are free-text rather than dropdowns: no budget bands are published anywhere on the site, so offering a fixed set would invent them. Both fields, plus the business name, are folded into the enquiry email by InnerPage's lead-form script.
devNotes.operationalClaims: The page promises a written quote within one business day. Confirmed with the client as deliverable before launch.
